title.en: Model execution profile and recommended defaults
title.zh: 模型执行档案与推荐默认值

summary.en: The public catalog now publishes optional reasoning effort levels, a default reasoning level, and a top-level defaults map for recommended models.
summary.zh: 公开目录现在发布可选的推理档位、默认推理档位，以及按操作推荐模型的顶层 defaults 映射。

body.en: `GET /api/pricing` text-model contracts may now carry optional `reasoning_efforts` (a map from the user-facing level to the upstream wire value) and `default_reasoning_effort`. The response may also carry a top-level `defaults` map recommending a model per operation (`chat`, `vision_chat`, `text_to_image`, `text_to_video`, `text_to_music`, `speech_to_text`). Every default value references a model present in the same response with non-empty `enable_groups`; unavailable recommendations are omitted rather than replaced. Missing reasoning fields stay absent and must not be treated as defaults. These fields are descriptive metadata only; pricing, routing, quota, precharge and settlement are unchanged.
body.zh: `GET /api/pricing` 的文本模型契约现在可携带可选的 `reasoning_efforts`（用户档位到上游 wire value 的映射）与 `default_reasoning_effort`。响应还可携带顶层 `defaults`，按操作推荐模型（`chat`、`vision_chat`、`text_to_image`、`text_to_video`、`text_to_music`、`speech_to_text`）。每个默认值都指向同一响应中 `enable_groups` 非空的模型；不可用的推荐直接省略，不会用其他模型替代。缺失的推理字段保持缺席，不得当作默认值。这些字段是纯描述数据；价格、路由、额度、预扣与结算均不变。
